sources.note: Main homepage. Overview of company as Florida-based EHR vendor for clinics of all sizes. Lists services: EMR/EHR, RCM, digital marketing, HIPAA compliance, telehealth. Mentions Simplify Therapy product for pediatric practices.
About page. Company based in Oviedo, FL. Emphasizes customizable EMR, no hidden fees. No founding date or team details provided.

ONC mandatory disclosures. SimplifyEMR v4.0 certified 2020-02-25. Requires MDToolBox additional software. Web-based. No additional costs for certified functionality. Supports 6 CQMs. Optional 2FA via text message.

EMR/EHR product page. Details on e-prescribing (40,000+ pharmacies, controlled substances, medication reconciliation), lab integration (trending, alerts, task assignment), interoperability connections (HIEs, pharmacies, payers, imaging, immunization registries).
Practice management page. Describes integrated scheduling, billing, charting. Cloud-based, HIPAA compliant, Meaningful Use Stage 3 certified. One-click patient record access.
Patient portal page. Features: online bill pay, messaging, appointment requests, prescription renewals, lab results viewing, educational materials, clinical summaries access.
Simplify Therapy page. Therapy-specific variant focusing on administrative/billing simplification for therapy practices. Part of broader Simplify ecosystem.

Simplify SMP page. School Medicaid Program billing tool for school districts. Manages Medicaid reimbursement for IDEA-related therapy services (speech, PT, OT, behavioral, nursing, transportation). Single login, multi-provider billing.
Blog/marketing page. General overview of EMR capabilities. Emphasizes customizability and patient-centric philosophy. Light on technical details.
Dedicated Simplify Therapy site. Pediatric Speech, OT, and PT EMR and Practice Management. Page was mostly CSS/styling with limited readable content.

FindEMR listing. No user reviews available on the platform (notes 4/5 aggregate from 10 reviews elsewhere). Describes target as practices with ~6 physicians or fewer. Subscription pricing, not publicly listed.
ZoomInfo listing (from search results). Indicates 11-12 employees, ~$7M annual revenue. Confirmed Oviedo, FL headquarters.
